title: PreviewSolveConfig
description: The reviewed configuration of the Team Preview solver (ADR-029 section 4): reviewed data in config/preview/<format>/, never code. Every value that changes what the solver plays is here or in an input the solver identity names. Integers only. Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is preview_solve_config_hash, a part of the solver identity. The values committed first are ADR-029's defaults; S0-P freezes them. A change of any value is a new record (a new file), never an edit.

format_id.description: The target format the solver is configured for.

kind.description: The simultaneous-game solve of the Team Preview payoff table.

k_own.description: How many of the pair's own Preview strategies (ordered lead pair, unordered back set) are rows of the table.

k_opp.description: How many of the opponent's ordered lead pairs are columns of the table.

selection_rule.description: prior-top-k takes the k_own most probable strategies, ties in canonical order; distinct-leads takes the next strategy only if its ordered lead pair is new.

n.description: Opponent teams drawn from the belief per decision (N_w).

min_valid.description: A solve needs at least this many worlds whose every table entry was produced; fewer plays the pair's own Preview.

prior.description: The prior arm the worlds are drawn from and the label every result of the arm carries.

belief_identity_hash.description: ADR-025's belief_identity_hash of the belief the worlds are drawn from: 64 lower-case hex digits. The solver identity names the same value and the reader refuses a different one.

leaf.description: How an entry of the table is valued: the worker's value at our first move request, or after a rollout of the given number of turns by the pair's Battle network.

solver.description: The matrix solve. iterations is present exactly for the iterative kinds (regret-matching, regret-matching-plus); exact-support is declared by the ADR and not built.

budget_ms.description: The per-decision guard in milliseconds that an overrun is a latency forfeit against; not a cut-off inside the solve, whose work is fixed by k_own, k_opp, N_w and the leaf.

a2_clock_floor_ms.description: A2 only: below this remaining bank the solve is skipped and the pair's own Preview is played.

seed_derivation.description: The draw from the solver's mixture: u is the first 53 bits of SHA-256 over the JCS of {seed, game, player, policy_id, request_seq, purpose: 'preview-solve/1'}.
